title: explain_job faithfulness, against a real model
notes: The model half. Generates an explanation for each of the ten fixture postings with the PRODUCTION prompt (EXPLAIN_SYSTEM_PROMPT and explainGrounding are imported, never copied — the 2026-08-21 bake-off rule) and runs the same post-generation checker explain_job runs. Nightly, never per-PR: it spends money and it is non-deterministic, and the plan's owner default is that Gemini-backed suites run only in the nightly workflow. Its deterministic sibling `explain-faithfulness-check` carries the gate. Reports `skipped` without a key rather than failing.
